You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC task d972feef — fill framed cavities by interior-size parity

Verified solved on the current instance with 1 wrong submission and 2 demo requests.

## Rule
Find closed, axis-aligned square frames in a uniform-background grid. Preserve every frame pixel and all exterior/background cells. Fill only the enclosed interior, choosing color by the side length of the interior (not by frame color): odd side length -> color 7; even side length -> color 2.

Evidence covers cavity side lengths 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. The parity rule explains the demos and accepted test. For a novel/non-square enclosure or size beyond the evidence, request a demo rather than assuming.

## Demo evidence
- Demo 1: a 4x4 color-6 frame with 2x2 cavity -> 2; an 8x8 color-1 frame with 6x6 cavity -> 2. (The frame bounds in the shown demo are rows 3–6, cols 0–3, and rows 7–14, cols 5–12.)
- Demo 2: 3x3 color-5 frame with 1x1 cavity -> 7; 4x4 color-8 frame with 2x2 cavity -> 2; 7x7 color-6 frame with 5x5 cavity -> 7.
- Accepted current test: 4x4 color-5 frame with 2x2 cavity -> 2; 7x7 color-4 frame with 5x5 cavity -> 7; 3x3 color-5 frame with 1x1 cavity -> 7.

These examples show the fill color is independent of outline color and follows cavity side-length parity. Keep the original grid dimensions, outlines, and exterior cells unchanged.

## Accepted current test coordinates (zero-based)
- Rows 0–3, cols 4–7: color-5 4x4 outline; fill rows 1–2, cols 5–6 with 2.
- Rows 6–12, cols 13–19: color-4 7x7 outline; fill rows 7–11, cols 14–18 with 7.
- Rows 14–16, cols 10–12: color-5 3x3 outline; fill row 15, col 11 with 7.
